name: BetterBank FavorRouterWrapper unvalidated-pair ESTEEM bonus minting
summary: FavorRouterWrapper.swapExactTokensForFavorAndTrackBonus only checks that the swap path ends in a registered FAVOR token, so any input token and any PulseX pair qualifies, and the FAVOR token's logBuy then credits an ESTEEM bonus on the bought amount. FAVOR's 50% sell tax applies only to whitelisted market pairs. The attacker created a worthless token, paired it with FAVOR, wash-traded 25 untaxed round trips to farm ESTEEM, redeemed it for freshly minted FAVOR, and sold that FAVOR into the official pairs, draining pDAI, PLSX and WPLS.

loss.notes: Quantities are exact gross depletion of the three official FAVOR market pairs, netted from each campaign receipt's Transfer logs, and include the 25,000-unit flash-loan premium paid out of each drain. pDAI/PDAIF pair 0xa0126ac1364606bafb150653c7bc9f1af4283dfa loses 890,899,504.360636360162048223 pDAI in the anchor; its balanceOf falls from 1,135,797,919.86 at block 24343024 to 244,898,415.50 at block 24343025. PLSX/PLSXF pair 0x24264d580711474526e8f2a8ccb184f6438bb95c loses 9,051,562,270.599955394519949325 PLSX in source-2, and WPLS/PLSF pair 0xdca85efdce177b24de8b17811cec007fe5098586 loses 7,409,355,692.988930176285433904 WPLS in source-3. The attacker supplied no value: flash loans were repaid in-transaction, and the FAVOR sold into the pairs was minted from farmed ESTEEM. That FAVOR is not netted against the drained reserves. Valuation is realised proceeds wherever the attacker sold, because every sale filled well below the pre-exploit DefiLlama quote. Of 890,874,504.36 pDAI received, 190,874,504.36 were sold for 396,945.3679 Ethereum-bridged DAI and 150,000,000 for 431,748.410207 bridged USDT, both taken at par. That is 0.00243 USD per pDAI against the 0.00501604 quote. All PLSX received sold for 263,979.344321 bridged USDC, and all WPLS for 70.078649042369470052 bridged WETH (4,472.85 USD/ETH, source-13). The realised unit rates are applied to the full depleted quantities, which include the unsold premiums. The remaining 550,000,000.000000000000000001 pDAI was never sold: the attacker transferred it to 0xce04c590344c2bd8e2bfe49a280c1d501dc8c000 in 0x51d91f4974ac5a152e2fda0a854f645826dc6efff4fabf325480718c305a0ff5 (block 24349712), the reported negotiated return. With the 25,000 pDAI premium it is valued at the pre-exploit quote 0.00501604, and the return does not reduce gross loss. The sales ran from block 24343052 to 24348986, after the last campaign transaction; their valuation timestamps are pinned to the anchor, as in other realised-proceeds records. Cross-checks: pricing every quantity at the pre-exploit DefiLlama quotes gives 5,119,420.82 USD, matching the reported ~$5M. Realised proceeds alone total 1,406,124.30 USD, matching Securelist's ~$1.4M net-profit figure. ESTEEM minted to the attacker and the treasury is not counted as loss.

ageReset.description: The immutable FavorRouterWrapper runtime contains the missing input-token/pair validation in swapExactTokensForFavorAndTrackBonus. Its only pre-exploit owner calls were three addFavorToken registrations, which leave that validation unchanged.

limitations: Not the knot: the combination this wrapper exploits in the anchor became live only when PDAIF's buy bonus was re-enabled at block 24243164 (target-2), 2,150 seconds after this deployment.

ageReset.description: setBonusRates(4400, 2500) on PDAIF re-enabled the buy bonus: bonusRate() goes from 0 at block 24243163 to 4400 at block 24243164 and stays 4400 through block 24343024. At bonusRate 0, calculateFavorBonuses returns zero user and treasury bonus, so the wash trades mint no ESTEEM. The value is therefore necessary to the exploited condition. The newly deployed wrapper had been installed as PDAIF's buy wrapper 161 blocks earlier (setBuyWrapper, block 24243003).

sources.note: Root cause and earliest exercise. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) on source-1 (served by https://rpc-pulsechain.g4mm4.io) shows a single transaction. Attacker EOA 0x48c9f537f3f1a2c95c46891332e05da0d268869b, nonce 0 at block 24343024, CREATEs 0x18dd9e3f039f319c854c389fc87b5295d3cb7f94, which CREATEs 0xa098da0d55cbe117b53c05d39306b23317d9a5d6. Steps: (1) an Aave-style flash loan through pool proxy 0xdb2c92c63e0320511a278673f0dbf8c3aca7c5ee supplies 50,000,000 pDAI (log 29) plus pDAI/PDAIF LP tokens. (2) PulseXRouter02.removeLiquidity takes 1,091,560,977.61 pDAI (log 35) and PDAIF from market pair 0xa0126ac1364606bafb150653c7bc9f1af4283dfa. (3) The inner contract CREATEs worthless token 0xe9389efad4c47b32d2d3b8df72f66d2ec7a4af30 and, via PulseXFactory.createPair (CREATE2), pair 0x1a26c6e2b2a8e6a329ab86d77cf9cfa18f47cb56 of that token and PDAIF. (4) 25 iterations of FavorRouterWrapper 0x30dcc4e72dcd2702449190ce8b88d21f2178cd9c: swapExactTokensForFavorAndTrackBonus (selector 0x10f04583, path [0xe9389e..., PDAIF]) then swapExactFavorForTokens (0xc45c87bd, path [PDAIF, 0xe9389e...]). Each buy calls MinterOracle.getTokenTWAP (twap < 3e18) and PDAIF.logBuy (0xf8ba0260), and each logBuy mints the treasury ESTEEM share via Esteem 0xdbb8fd196e804d05bb8047dd3e91a9245b7819a7.mint. The 25 EsteemBonusLogged events credit 2,871,049.240159910011481851 ESTEEM to the attacker and mint 717,762.310039977502870453 to the treasury. isMarketPair(0x1a26c6e2...) is 0 at block 24343024 while sellTax() is 5000, so the sells back into the fake pair are untaxed. (5) PDAIF.claimBonus mints the 2,871,049.24 ESTEEM (UserBonusClaimed, log 459). MintRedeemer 0x6bbc91c980780c393e9dac11ec58684191de611d burns it and mints 3,816,638,675.767920771647358222 PDAIF to the inner contract (log 462). (6) Liquidity is re-added through LPZapper, the minted PDAIF is swapped into the market pair for 891,445,284.85 pDAI (log 480), and the loan is repaid (50,025,000 pDAI, log 489). 890,874,504.360636360162048223 pDAI go to the EOA (log 491). Verified source (source-9) makes the defect explicit: swapExactTokensForFavorAndTrackBonus requires only isFavorToken[path[last]] and path.length == 2. It never validates path[0] or the pair against the FAVOR market-pair set, so logBuy credits bonuses for wash trades through attacker pairs that FAVOR._transfer does not tax. The Zokyo July 2025 audit reportedly flagged the path and was downgraded to informational (source-14). Sources 2 and 3 repeat the same sequence 130 and 150 seconds later. Source-2: contract 0x767c5a70cda0d9469cce3a56653e1d170d9849c3, inner 0xbb6fdadcf3cbd22a3bd109ae42c24463f7001c8b, fake pair 0x615f19af7deae01b4c77c7066fc36b74c6f53161, against PLSXF 0x47c3038ad52e06b9b4aca6d672ff9ff39b126806 (market pair 0x24264d58...). Source-3: 0x792cdc4adcf6b33880865a200319ecbc496e98f8 and 0x15360369aa7ce4499219eb5793c5a0159f393e16, fake pair 0x8ec2f47a17e1e5073722528d34413890713c7521, against PLSF 0x30be72a397667fdfd641e3e5bd68db657711eb20 (market pair 0xdca85efd...). Both go through the same wrapper, 25 logBuy calls each. Earliest-use scan: eth_getLogs EsteemBonusLogged(address,uint256,uint256) on PDAIF, PLSXF and PLSF, blocks 24158000..24343100, returns 1294/544/2264 logs in 4030 transactions; eth_getTransactionReceipt for all of them. In every transaction, locate the PulseX pair (a Swap-event emitter) that transfers FAVOR out. Every buy comes from the token's single MarketPairUpdated pair (a0126ac1 / 24264d58 / dca85efd), except the 26 transfers per campaign transaction from the three attacker-created pairs. The only logBuy without a swap is a direct owner call, 0xfaa3d61d34b4b14a23d4c9bf800d6542844fe4755f77590c0411991b4f8442d5 (block 24242607). Source-1 is therefore the first exercise. From block 24343040 to 27662140 only 4 further EsteemBonusLogged events occur (PLSF), all buys from the PLSF market pair. The owner broke the wrapper with setRouter(owner) in 0xb9bcdf6a1cfad30a4c2289c3f3852b4829ff698883706c6c1f05c9bb27b8168f (block 24343074) and set all bonus rates to zero at block 24472628.

Verified Solidity from the PulseChain Blockscout API: https://api.scan.pulsechain.com/api?module=contract&action=getsourcecode&address=<addr>. FavorRouterWrapper 0x30dcc4e72dcd2702449190ce8b88d21f2178cd9c: v0.8.20+commit.a1b79de6, optimizer 200 runs; SHA-256 of the returned SourceCode is 2c6cad9603285a98d8dc5b5cecd75fa3dfd64308587c03cc378c910fbfeab709. Inspect swapExactTokensForFavorAndTrackBonus and swapExactFavorForTokens. PDAIF 0xbc91e5ae4ce07d0455834d52a9a4df992e12fe12: same compiler settings; SHA-256 071508acbd6025e465a3c161d2e1ac69e005dc5b58d3dc7945fac2fca9a005e4. Inspect logBuy (checks only isBuyWrapper[msg.sender]), calculateFavorBonuses (bonus proportional to bonusRate), _transfer (sell tax only when isMarketPair[recipient]) and claimBonus. PLSXF and PLSF are verified instances of the same template.

Target identity and age history, all via https://rpc.pulsechain.com. Wrapper 0x30dcc4e72dcd2702449190ce8b88d21f2178cd9c: eth_getCode is empty at block 24242951. keccak256(runtime) is 0x460d2c2f7e619d86f0d7006dbaf8ca17a401c01c6733e49b21723d28385f90d2 at 24242952, at 24343024 and at latest. The source-4 receipt shows a top-level creation, contractAddress = wrapper, from 0xc0702ae0374f83fc3ba71ce2b30a323b09ec19da at index 61. The runtime has no upgrade, delegatecall or selfdestruct path. Blockscout txlist for the wrapper, paged 250 at a time, returns 4132 transactions. Its non-swap calls are the deployment, addFavorToken(PDAIF/PLSXF/PLSF) at blocks 24242957/24242959/24242962, and the post-exploit setRouter at 24343074. There is no pre-exploit setOracle or setRouter. PDAIF 0xbc91e5ae4ce07d0455834d52a9a4df992e12fe12: code is empty at block 24158432. keccak256(runtime) is 0x39b57888ac19f3536a140894c105a3fe3d377a1867067ffd88f4d7f1b8fcb014 at 24158433, at 24343024 and at latest. The source-5 receipt shows a top-level creation by the same deployer at index 43. The token is immutable. PDAIF config history comes from eth_getLogs, blocks 24158000..24343024. BuyWrapperUpdated has 8 events, all adding a wrapper; the last is the wrapper here, in source-7 (block 24243003, tx index 43, log 492). MarketPairUpdated has one event, a0126ac1 at block 24158844. BonusRatesUpdated has 8 events alternating (0,0) and (4400,2500), at blocks 24158447, 24171814, 24173484, 24176459, 24200756, 24219140, 24220179 and 24243164. The last, source-6 at tx index 40, log 150, turns the bonus on. Its calldata is setBonusRates(0x1130, 0x9c4) from the owner, and eth_call bonusRate() (0x5af123f4) returns 0 at block 24243163 and 0x1130 at blocks 24243164 and 24343024. isBuyWrapper(wrapper) is 0 at 24243002 and 1 at 24243003..24343024. wrapper.isFavorToken(PDAIF) is 1 from 24242957. There is no SellTaxUpdated event, and sellTax() is 5000 throughout. The next BonusRatesUpdated is the post-exploit (0,0) at block 24472628. The exploitable combination is: wrapper deployed, registered in both directions, and bonus enabled. It first existed at the source-6 reset, which strictly precedes the anchor and is the latest pre-exploit change necessary to the condition. The earlier ESTEEM/MintRedeemer/minter wiring is ordinary wiring that predates the reset: Esteem MinterAdded(PDAIF) at 24158462 and MinterAdded(MintRedeemer) at 24160252, with no MinterRemoved through 24343024; PDAIF addMinter(MintRedeemer) at 24160260; setEsteemMinter at 24171827. PDAIF is aged from this reset, which makes it the curve target. The wrapper's own deployment is 2,150 seconds earlier. The PLSXF and PLSF legs (sources 2 and 3) ran against sibling tokens whose last bonus enable was at blocks 24243163 and 24242280 and whose wrapper install was at 24243011 and 24243006. They join this incident as later legs of the same campaign.
